walkthrough:
Calculate the length of major arc $ARB$ with radius $r_1 = 2.5\text{ cm}$ and angle $\theta_1 = \frac{4\pi}{3}\text{ radians}$:
$$\text{Arc } ARB = 2.5 \times \frac{4\pi}{3} = \frac{10\pi}{3} \approx 10.472\text{ cm}$$

Calculate the length of arc $ASB$ with radius $r_2 = 2.24\text{ cm}$ and angle $\theta_2 = \frac{5\pi}{6}\text{ radians}$:
$$\text{Arc } ASB = 2.24 \times \frac{5\pi}{6} = \frac{28\pi}{15} \approx 5.864\text{ cm}$$

Sum the two arc lengths to find the total perimeter:
$$\text{Perimeter} = \frac{10\pi}{3} + \frac{28\pi}{15} = \frac{26\pi}{5} \approx 16.34\text{ cm}$$

ai_rubric.Circular Measure: Calculates individual arc lengths (B1M1). Obtains $16.34\text{ cm}$ (or $\frac{26\pi}{5}$) (A1).

walkthrough:
Calculate the area of triangle $AOB$ with sides $2.5\text{ cm}$ and angle $\angle AOB = 2\pi - \frac{4\pi}{3} = \frac{2\pi}{3}$:
$$\text{Area}(\triangle AOB) = \frac{1}{2}(2.5)^2\sin\left(\frac{2\pi}{3}\right) \approx 2.706\text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the area of triangle $APB$ with sides $2.24\text{ cm}$ and angle $\angle APB = 2\pi - \frac{5\pi}{6} = \frac{5\pi}{6}$ (or given angle $\frac{5\pi}{6}$):
$$\text{Area}(\triangle APB) = \frac{1}{2}(2.24)^2\sin\left(\frac{5\pi}{6}\right) \approx 1.254\text{ cm}^2$$

Subtract the two triangle areas to find the difference:
$$\text{Difference} = 2.706 - 1.254 = 1.452 \approx 1.45\text{ cm}^2$$

ai_rubric.Circular Measure: Calculates areas of both triangles (M1). Obtains difference $1.45\text{ cm}^2$ (A1).

skill_tags: Finding Areas of Composite Circular Regions

hints: Add both sector areas plus the triangle difference from part (b).
walkthrough:
Calculate the area of the two sectors:
$$\text{Area}(\text{Sector } AOB) = \frac{1}{2}(2.5)^2\left(\frac{4\pi}{3}\right) \approx 13.090\text{ cm}^2$$
$$\text{Area}(\text{Sector } APB) = \frac{1}{2}(2.24)^2\left(\frac{5\pi}{6}\right) \approx 6.568\text{ cm}^2$$

Add the two sector areas and the triangle area difference from part (b):
$$\text{Total Area} = 13.090 + 6.568 + 1.452$$

Evaluate the total cross-sectional area to $3$ significant figures:
$$\text{Area} = 21.11 \approx 21.1\text{ cm}^2$$

ai_rubric.Circular Measure: Calculates sector areas (B1). Adds sector areas and triangle difference (M1). Obtains $21.1\text{ cm}^2$ (A1).
